articles.title: Someone Finally Jailbroke the PS5—Just After Sony Said Players Don’t Own Their Games
articles.snippet: Linear Fox founder Nathan Fargo released a public jailbreak for the PS5, dubbed Relapse, while Sony argues in court that players don't own their digital games.
